 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 7 23-03-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
This application

has been filed for quashing of order dated 19.06.2018 passed by Learned C.J.M.,
Jehanabad in Complaint Case No. 635 of 2017 by which cognizance has been taken against the petitioner for the offences under Sections 406, 420, 468, 469 of the Indian Penal Code.
The impugned order has been passed on 19.06.2018 and the quashing application has been filed in 2019 after inordinate delay that too without satisfactory explanation of the Patna High Court CR.
Accordingly, this application is dismissed on the ground of delay and latches.
